subject.title: fix(runtime): cancelled workflows no longer continue external commands

question: Should Lobster preserve a workflow resume token when cancellation occurs during asynchronous setup, but permanently consume that token once the first workflow step has started?
rationale: This is a user-visible replay and retry policy for persisted continuation state; source review can verify the implementation, but cannot decide the repository's intended lifecycle contract.

options.title: Accept the first-step boundary
options.body: Keep setup-time cancellation retryable and consume the resolved resume state plus approval index after any started workflow abort.

options.title: Choose a stricter consumption boundary
options.body: Define an earlier lifecycle point at which cancellation should consume the token, then adjust the callback and regression coverage to match.

recommendation.title: Accept the first-step boundary
recommendation.body: Keep setup-time cancellation retryable and consume the resolved resume state plus approval index after any started workflow abort.

likelyOwner.reason: This contributor has the strongest available context for the cancellation mechanics and the prior review iterations; a repository owner should make the final policy choice.
